# ghost/world-clock

Read offline world clocks and current-time comparisons in Zham without location, accounts or alarms. Add exact IANA city zones, read native times, inspect converter snapshots and reset the app comparison to Now.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/world-clock
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/world-clock open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/world-clock read_clocks --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/world-clock add_city --device <serial> --param zone=<zone>
ghost skill run ghost/world-clock open_converter --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/world-clock read_conversion --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/world-clock reset_now --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/world-clock back_to_clocks --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open offline Zham city clocks
- `read_clocks`: Read visible cities, IANA zones and clock times
- `add_city`: Add an exact public IANA time zone to the local city list
- `open_converter`: Open a time comparison snapshot for the listed cities
- `read_conversion`: Read the reference city/date and visible time comparison snapshot
- `reset_now`: Reset the converter snapshot to the current instant
- `back_to_clocks`: Return from the converter to the live city clock list
